description: Checked Raya migration baseline. Public defects are fixed in small batches; compatibility keys require dual-read migration; provenance stays attributed; internal names migrate after public contracts stabilize.

user-visible-defect.reason: Potential user-facing Kilo names in extension manifests or rendered webview sources.

compatibility-key.reason: Persisted, protocol, package, command, path, provider, environment or API identity requiring a dual-read migration.

upstream-provenance.reason: Legal, attribution, fork documentation, translation process or upstream merge material.

internal-migration.reason: Internal source identity that can migrate after public and stored compatibility contracts stabilize.
